target: forge.sh pr-state (gitlab) — the project path is everything before /-/merge_requests/, at any depth, URL-encoded
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"; fx_init
fx_remote https://gitlab.example.test/grp/proj.git
export FORGE_TOKEN=glpat-FAKE-not-a-real-token-0001
fx_http "GET /api/v4/projects/a%2Fb%2Fc%2Fd/merge_requests/12" 200 '{"state":"merged"}'
fx_run pr-state https://gitlab.example.test/a/b/c/d/-/merge_requests/12; fx_show r
fx_reqs
fx_done
